##### Project General Facts

The Avencia Villas project boasts stunning homes that combine elegance and convenience, featuring state-of-the-art amenities that create a community ahead of its time. With homes inspired by Latin design, the urban experience blends seamlessly with nature, creating a unique lifestyle ecosystem. Avencia Villas features two and three bedroom homes with green yards, generous living rooms, kitchen spaces, powder and bathrooms, and ample parking.

Avencia Villas offers a range of amenities, including landscaped parks, pristine lakes, and rooftop gardens, providing a serene environment for residents to unwind. The villas are designed to be more than just places to live, but places to feel alive, with uncompromising levels of craftsmanship and inspired designs. Every aspect of the villas, from the generous living rooms to the rooftop gardens, is designed to create a unique living experience.

The interior of the Avencia Villas features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating a serene and comfortable living environment. With its focus on family and community, Avencia Villas is the perfect place to watch your family grow, surrounded by lush greenery and pristine lakes. The villas are designed to provide the perfect balance between nature and urban living, creating a unique lifestyle ecosystem that is unmatched in the region.


##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a master community that pays tribute to its predecessor while curating its own unique charm, featuring a crafted symphony of nature, wellness, activity, and community. The community boasts a range of amenities, including Malibu Beach, the Boating Lake and Cafe, and the Splash Pad and Slides, providing endless entertainment options for residents. With its easy access to major highways, Damac Hills 2 is strategically located, allowing residents to enjoy the best of both worlds.

Damac Hills 2 is home to Sports Town, a hub of sports activities featuring an outdoor gym, cricket pitch and nets, tennis and paddle tennis courts, volleyball, basketball, and football facilities, and much more. The community also features Down Town, a space dedicated to good energy and great times, with amenities like the Zen Garden, Hedge Maze, and Waterside Cafe. With its international school, world-class healthcare centre, and mosque, Damac Hills 2 provides residents with everything they need to live a fulfilling life.

The community at Damac Hills 2 is designed to provide a unique lifestyle experience, with amenities like the Community Mall, Carrefour supermarket, and the Floating Cinema. The community is surrounded by lush greenery and pristine lakes, creating a serene environment for residents to unwind. With its focus on community and family, Damac Hills 2 is the perfect place to live, work, and play, providing a unique lifestyle experience that is unmatched in the region.
